task_description: Redesign the static Incredible India travel-guide site in place: shared design system (styles.css), self-contained SVG logo/favicon, shared site.js (mobile menu, reveals, image fallback), five redesigned pages (home, destinations, travel tips, gallery, contact) with local SVG images, accessible nav/footer, gallery lightbox, contact form validation, and a rewritten README. Plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS only, no build step, all assets local.
